rule_compatibility.rule: initial stop and fixed take profit
rule_compatibility.reason: formulas are exact, but price levels depend on leverage and same-candle order is unresolved at 5m
activation and stop formulas are exact, but leverage and intrabar ordering are not bound
canonical dev data can provide earlier candles, but the D1A trajectory artifact itself starts at entry and exact live polling/order timing is absent
formula is exact, but this was a fallback whose activation depends on ATR availability
requires future model actions, scores, votes and consecutive counters not frozen by D1A
the historical rule starts after eight hours; D1A ends after one hour

intrabar_limitations: A five-minute candle can cross initial stop and take profit without revealing which executed first.
A candle can cross a trailing activation and its resulting stop without revealing event order.
The live service managed marks and exchange orders asynchronously; OHLC bars do not encode that schedule.
Fail-conservative ordering would be a new simulation convention, not recovered historical behavior.
required_owner_decisions: bind a leverage rule to each D1A entry
choose whether to exclude ExitEye or reconstruct a separately frozen signal stream
choose an evaluation horizon compatible with the eight-hour conditional timeout
define the risk unit used for any R-denominated policy
